book_id.description: The book's ReadingRate id or its library entry id

reading_number.description: Which reading: 1 for the first, 2 for a reread. Default: the latest

timezone.description: IANA time zone the days are counted in, for example "Europe/London"

name: get_reading_days

book.description: The book: id, slug, title, authors

current_page_label.description: current_page as the book prints it, e.g. "liv" or "10"

days.description: One entry per day with a page change, oldest first

basis.description: log: recorded changes; end_date: the reader's finish date, at the last page

furthest_page.description: The highest page reached that day

furthest_page_label.description: furthest_page as the book prints it (only with front matter)

last_page.description: The page the reader left off at that day

pages_read.description: Pages from where the day began to furthest_page; null when unknown

percent.description: furthest_page as a percent of the reader's copy

front_matter_pages.description: Roman-numbered pages at the front of the reader's copy (an introduction numbered i–lx is 60). When set, every page here counts from page i, and the *_label fields give the page as printed

logged_since.description: When the first page change of this reading was recorded; days before it are not known

note.description: What the days do and do not cover

reading_number.description: Which reading of the book: 1 for the first, 2 for a reread

reverse_numbering.description: The book counts down to page 1: its furthest page each day is the lowest

timezone.description: The time zone the days are counted in

total_pages.description: Printed pages in the reader's copy, without a roman-numbered introduction; percent counts the whole copy

title: Get reading days
